reasoning: The two code diffs are byte-for-byte the same: both drop VALID_NAMES in favor of the BlockTypes.ByName lookup and change nothing else. Both write-ups reject items 1–4 and 6 with sound reasons, and both treat item 3 as a correctness bug. A wins narrowly for two reasons. Its profiling advice covers both server time and network traffic (MicroProfiler plus the Script Performance and Network tabs). B states a performance measurement for part reuse ('about a third of the cost') with no source behind it. B's richer discussion of pool reset costs almost closes the gap, but not quite.
